item.title: Trinket 0.1.0 Preview (8)
item.description:
### Added
- Workflow packages can receive signed live updates with Pinned or Automatic policies; updates needing setup keep the current workflow usable until setup is complete. Workflows settings exposes publisher review, policy controls, release notes and applied update history. - App startup preserves pre-migration database checkpoints across failed upgrades and retries, and offers Retry Startup while retaining credential-key protections. - Show configured package and workflow labels, with input names below run headings. - Runs started with a JSON object input show its title or text field as their title, so Git message checks are named in the run list. - Packages can declare their update source and default channel; trusted signed archives configure updates while preserving pins, channels, opt-outs and local packages. - Workflow authors can create change fragments and prepare reviewed release notes and version plans with the Bun release utility.
### Changed
- Workflow submissions receive a retryable update-pending response while an app restart waits for accepted workflows and package installs to finish. - The engine and workflow boxes now run on Bun 1.4.4.
### Fixed
- Switching workflows and collapsing sidebar folders clears the previous selection highlight without leaving an overlapping row. - Active workflows keep their settings and credentials during updates or removal; unused data is cleaned up when they finish.
